name: fantasy-football-skills
description: Fantasy football decision-support skills for Claude Code: draft strategy, waiver wire, trade analysis, and browser-driven roster operations.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: One-time league interview that writes a leagues.md config file every other skill reads. Install this first.

plugins.name: draft-strategy
plugins.description: Draft prep and live-draft decision support: tiered boards, value-based drafting, best-available logic, and keeper math.

plugins.name: waiver-wire
plugins.description: In-season roster churn: waiver scans matched to your roster holes, FAAB bid sizing, and safe drop candidates.

plugins.name: trade-analyzer
plugins.description: Two-sided trade evaluation, league-wide trade finding, and counteroffer reasoning.

plugins.name: roster-ops
plugins.description: Browser-automation playbooks that set lineups, submit waiver claims, and propose trades in your own logged-in session. Never touches credentials; always confirms before submitting.
